value.name: reveal estate costs and loan
value.description: A financial update reveals that the house has accumulated costs and that the bank has flagged a private loan their mother took out against the property.
evidence: he house has accumulated, and the bank has flagged a private loan your mother took out two years ago against the property, which is current but accruing. Nothing catastrophic. But the longer the estate sits open, the more it costs everyone.

value.name: Daniel pushes to list the house
value.description: Daniel immediately argues that the house should be listed and says he already has an agent and a potential buyer.
evidence: "Which is why we should list the house," Daniel said, immediately, as if she had teed up a serve for him. "I have an agent ready. She thinks we can be under contract in three weeks. There's a buyer already, actually, who saw it last year when Mom was thinking about a reverse mortgage."

value.name: Lucia disputes reverse mortgage claim
value.description: Lucia challenges Daniel's account, insisting their mother was never considering a reverse mortgage.
evidence: Lucia set her mug down. "Mom was never thinking about a reverse mortgage."

value.name: Lucia explains house visit
value.description: Lucia clarifies that someone came to the house for an insurance reassessment, not a reverse mortgage consultation.
evidence: "She had someone come look at the house."
"For insurance reassessment. Rosa was here. Rosa, tell him."

value.name: Rosa confirms insurance man visit
value.description: Rosa backs Lucia's version by identifying the visitor as the insurance man.
evidence: Rosa, who was standing rather than sitting, said, "It was the insurance man."

value.name: Daniel dismisses dispute
value.description: Daniel refuses to engage with the disagreement and insists the house has already been valued and they need to move forward.
evidence: Daniel did not look at her. He looked at Asha. "The point is, the house has been valued. We don't need to relitigate every conversation. We need to move."

value.name: Asha requests complete file
value.description: Asha calmly asks for the complete estate file and asks whether anyone knows of any additional testamentary documents.
evidence: "Before we move," Asha said, in the voice she used to bring temperatures down without seeming to, "I want to be sure we have the complete file. The will I'm working from is the one on record with the bank. Is there anything anyone is aware of that might supplement it. Letters of intent. Amendments. Codicils."

value.name: family falls into tense silence
value.description: A tense silence follows Asha's question, with each family member reacting differently and Rosa appearing to wait for something to be revealed.
evidence: There was a silence then that was not quite the silence she had expected. Daniel's was impatient. Lucia's was held. Rosa's was a kind of waiting, the way a person waits at a bus stop knowing the bus is coming.

value.name: Rosa begins to reveal something
value.description: Rosa starts to say that there was something, implying she knows of an additional document or fact.
